using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.server;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class MultiDatabaseManagerTests
    {
        private class TestStoreWrapper : StoreWrapper
        {
            public TestStoreWrapper()
            {
                serverOptions = new ServerOptions
                {
                    FailOnRecoveryError = false,
                    MainStoreCheckpointBaseDirectory = "baseDir",
                    MaxDatabases = 10
                };
            }
        }

        private class TestMultiDatabaseManager : MultiDatabaseManager
        {
            public TestMultiDatabaseManager(StoreWrapper storeWrapper)
                : base((id) => new GarnetDatabase(id, storeWrapper), storeWrapper, false)
            {
            }

            public bool TryGetSavedDatabaseIdsThrows { get; set; } = false;

            protected override bool TryGetSavedDatabaseIds(string checkpointParentDir, string checkpointDirBaseName, out int[] dbIds)
            {
                if (TryGetSavedDatabaseIdsThrows)
                {
                    throw new Exception("Simulated exception in TryGetSavedDatabaseIds");
                }
                dbIds = new[] { 0 };
                return true;
            }

            public bool RecoverDatabaseCheckpointThrows { get; set; } = false;

            protected override void RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint(GarnetDatabase db, out long storeVersion, out long objectStoreVersion)
            {
                storeVersion = 1;
                objectStoreVersion = 1;
                if (RecoverDatabaseCheckpointThrows)
                {
                    throw new Exception("Simulated exception in RecoverDatabaseCheckpoint");
                }
            }

            public ILogger LoggerPublic
            {
                get => Logger;
                set => Logger = value;
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsInformationOnTryGetSavedDatabaseIdsException()
        {
            var storeWrapper = new TestStoreWrapper();
            var manager = new TestMultiDatabaseManager(storeWrapper);

            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            manager.LoggerPublic = mockLogger.Object;

            manager.TryGetSavedDatabaseIdsThrows = true;

            // Act
            manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Error during recovery of database ids")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RecoverCheckpoint_LogsInformationOnRecoverDatabaseCheckpointException()
        {
            var storeWrapper = new TestStoreWrapper();
            var manager = new TestMultiDatabaseManager(storeWrapper);

            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            manager.LoggerPublic = mockLogger.Object;

            manager.RecoverDatabaseCheckpointThrows = true;

            // Act
            manager.RecoverCheckpoint();

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Error during recovery of store")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
